description: This file defines the GeneratorImpl class, an abstract base class for pseudo-random number generators in the ATen library, including thread safety notes, seed management, and state handling.

classes.name: c10::GeneratorImpl
classes.description: Abstract class representing a generator for pseudo-random numbers, with thread safety, seed, state management, and device association.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the generator.

methods.name: set_current_seed
methods.description: Sets the seed for the generator.

methods.name: set_offset
methods.description: Sets the offset for the generator.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the internal state of the generator.

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Retrieves the internal state of the generator.

methods.name: graphsafe_set_state
methods.description: Sets the state in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: graphsafe_get_state
methods.description: Gets the state in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: device
methods.description: Returns the device associated with the generator.

methods.name: clone_impl
methods.description: Internal method to clone the generator implementation.
